snippet.title: Cards Everywhere! Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5063140/Cards_Everywhere/
Cards Everywhere! is a cozy organizing game where you sort through 2,000 scattered cards, collect over 1,500 unique ones, and place them in your collection album. Discover dozens of unique sets and unlock helpful abilities as your collection grows.
